description:
Bulk Sell adds category-based selling for loose weapons, hullmod specs, and fighter LPCs. Choose what to clear out. Remembers locked items/reserve quantity in your campaign.

Download Bulk Sell 0.2.2
No dependencies

What it does

Filter weapons by type and size, including Ballistic, Energy, Missile, Small, Medium, and Large.
Filter by the item's in-game tech/manufacturer label or its source content mod. Labels are discovered from loaded items, including modded equipment.
Set default and per-item keep quantities, or lock an item type with Keep all.
Save selections, modes, locks, and keep quantities per campaign, separately for weapons, hullmods, and LPCs.
Review owned / kept / sell quantities before adding anything to the market transaction.

Screenshots

Inclusive — sell selected categories.

Exclusive — sell everything except selected categories.

Click Review batch, then Add reviewed batch to sale.
Close the panel and use Starsector's normal trade confirmation or cancellation.

Supports vanilla open, black, and military markets, Nexerelin's replacements, and the AoTD Theory of Toolbox + Nexerelin replacements. Tested with Nexerelin 0.12.2d and Theory of Toolbox 1.0.13.
Tested at 1920x1080 and 3840x2160.
